name: wp-toolkit
description: Dev tooling for the Zestry WP Toolkit toolkit (WordPress integration test environment).

scripts.test:php:coverage: wp-env --config .wp-env.test.json run --env-cwd='wp-content/plugins/wp-toolkit' wordpress php -d xdebug.mode=coverage vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml.dist --coverage-text --coverage-clover build/clover.xml
scripts.test:php:ms:base: wp-env --config .wp-env.test.json run --env-cwd='wp-content/plugins/wp-toolkit' wordpress bash -c 'WP_MULTISITE=1 vendor/bin/phpunit -c phpunit.xml.dist'
